intelligence.economy_brief: The OSRS market is in a low-volatility, high-stale regime with turnover-weighted price pressure near zero. Breadth is slightly positive but dominated by a few high-turnover names, while liquidity is bifurcated between deep blue-chip books and thin long-tail inventory.
intelligence.market_mood: Cautious, range-bound, and rotationally selective; capital is concentrating in a handful of high-conviction opportunities while the majority of the book remains stale.
intelligence.regime: OFFICIAL: normal patch cycle (no emergency update), CONFIRMED_COMMUNITY: polished-button economics verified, COMMUNITY: ongoing flip of high-margin consumables, RUMOR: upcoming PvP content speculation, MODEL_INFERENCE: frontier-lab ensemble flags mild risk-off tilt.

Model inference shows velocity and market maker converging on similar edge signals (depth + momentum + cross_factor), while frontier adds shock/catalyst interactions. No macro shock detected; microstructure improving on select high-volume books.
intelligence.summary: Velocity is actively deploying capital into confirmed edge trades (dragon knife, annakarl tablets, cupronickel) with tight stop logic. Across funds, turnover-weighted pressure is muted but microstructure is improving on depth and spread capture.

assumptions: Read-only replay; never touches live wallet state.

Passive fills remain the deterministic expected-fill model used by the paper engine; this is diagnostic, not a claim about real GE queue fills.
The LLM semantic prior is disabled in replay so strategy diagnostics remain deterministic and reproducible.
The usual weekly update-window prior is evaluated at each historical replay timestamp rather than using the current live clock.
